How ordering works

  1. Pick your pairChoose a style and size, then tap Order on WhatsApp. Your message includes a link to the exact picture.

Questions, answered

Anything else? Tutor Samuel replies on WhatsApp.

Message us on WhatsApp
How long does an order take?

About 4 days from order to your door. Once your pair is complete, we deliver within 48 hours.

Do you deliver outside Lagos?

Yes. We deliver nationwide.

How do I pay?

You pay in installments. A first payment gets your pair started, and you pay the rest when it arrives.

How much does a pair cost?

Send us the pair you like on WhatsApp and Tutor Samuel will reply with the price.

Do you make child sizes?

Yes. Open any design and choose “Child sizes” (28 to 35) before you order.

What if my size is between two?

Go up one size, or message us on WhatsApp and we will help you choose.
